name: dsh-electron
description: DeepSeek Harness desktop shell: runs the dsh web app as a child process and loads it in an Electron window.

scripts.package: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run standalone && pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run standalone:x64 && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 && pnpm run standalone:arm64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:win: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run standalone && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run standalone && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:standalone: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run standalone
